title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: A ROC curve plots the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. The area under the curve (AUC) is a measure of how well the model can distinguish between classes.

title: Choosing the Starting Point for Thresholds
text: Consider the range of values that the predicted probabilities can take. What is the minimum value that these probabilities can have?

title: Thresholds in ROC Curves
text: Thresholds are used to convert predicted probabilities into binary classifications. By varying the threshold, you can calculate different TPR and FPR values to plot the ROC curve.
